headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts Anew; Stlican Shelf Line Shifts
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse overturns our last edition's quiet: thirteen base events in the past two hours alone, sixty-two in a day, with two strategic posts blasted into no-man's-land and the Warden count there cut from six holds to four against three Colonial. The broader pace has cooled, yet the latest hour quickens again. Stlican Shelf churns in step — twenty-three events, a Warden base lost to leave the split at three-five with one ruin, and Breaker Town contested seventeen times, the newest exchange barely an hour old. Fisherman's Row, which led our previous report, has slackened; its last movement came near 07:44, though the Wardens have recovered a third hold there. Callahan's Passage, after twenty-nine events and some twenty-two thousand casualties in a day, has been silent since the small hours, as has Mooring County, last heard before four. The Nevish Line bucks the lull, its casualty rate accelerating sharply on both sides of an otherwise unchanged eight-base Warden front. It is day 401 of this war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
